terms.value: Northwind Analytics Ltd and Fabrikam Robotics Inc
terms.source_sentence: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is made on 1 March 2026 between Northwind Analytics Ltd, a company registered in England, and Fabrikam Robotics Inc, a Delaware corporation.
This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is made on 1 March 2026 between Northwind Analytics Ltd, a company registered in England, and Fabrikam Robotics Inc, a Delaware corporation.

terms.value: Keep the other party's information secret, use it only to evaluate the partnership, and protect it with at least reasonable care.
terms.source_sentence: Each Recipient shall keep the Confidential Information of the other party secret, shall use it solely for the Purpose, and shall protect it with at least reasonable care.

terms.value: To employees and professional advisers who need to know, or where required by law or a court order (with prompt written notice).
terms.source_sentence: A Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to its employees and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose, or where required by law or by a court order, provided it gives the Discloser prompt written notice.

terms.value: 3 years; confidentiality obligations survive termination for a further 2 years.
terms.source_sentence: This Agreement continues for three (3) years from the Effective Date, and the confidentiality obligations survive termination for a further two (2) years.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

terms.value: Exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales
terms.source_sentence: The courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of this Agreement.

terms.value: Confidential Information stays the property of the Discloser; no licence is granted.
terms.source_sentence: All Confidential Information remains the property of the Discloser, and nothing in this Agreement grants the Recipient any licence or other rights in it.

terms.value: No soliciting of the other party's employees for 12 months after the agreement ends.
terms.source_sentence: For twelve (12) months after this Agreement ends, neither party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other party it met through the Purpose.
Each breach shall incur liquidated damages of £50,000.
